checks.label: Boot Mode Status
checks.description: Device boot mode - fastboot/recovery/charger modes allow partition modification
checks.remediation: Reboot the device normally. If stuck in recovery or fastboot, investigate the cause before rebooting.

checks.label: vbmeta Device State
checks.description: vbmeta device_state must be locked
checks.remediation: Re-lock the bootloader via 'fastboot flashing lock' after flashing stock firmware.

checks.label: AVB Version Present
checks.description: AVB version should be present
checks.remediation: Ensure the device firmware includes AVB support. Flash a firmware build that ships with vbmeta.

checks.label: avbctl Present
checks.command: command -v avbctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo present || echo absent
checks.description: avbctl binary available for rollback checks
checks.remediation: Install or restore the avbctl binary from the vendor partition or OEM system image.

checks.label: Rollback Index (slot 0) > 0
checks.command: command -v avbctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && avbctl get-rollback-index 0 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}' || echo 0
checks.description: Anti-rollback index should be > 0 (slot 0) (INFO if avbctl unavailable)
checks.remediation: Apply the latest OTA update to advance the rollback index. Ensure avbctl is available on the device.

checks.label: Rollback Index (slot 1) > 0
checks.command: command -v avbctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && avbctl get-rollback-index 1 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}' || echo 0
checks.description: Anti-rollback index should be > 0 (slot 1) (INFO if avbctl unavailable)
checks.remediation: Apply the latest OTA update to advance the rollback index. Ensure avbctl is available on the device.

checks.label: OEM Unlock Allowed
checks.description: Should be disabled to prevent unlock
checks.remediation: Disable OEM unlocking in Settings > Developer Options > OEM Unlocking.

checks.label: Safe Mode
checks.description: Should not be running in Safe Mode
checks.remediation: Reboot the device normally to exit Safe Mode.

checks.label: FRP Policy
checks.description: Factory Reset Protection should be enabled
checks.remediation: Add a Google account and enable FRP via device policy or MDM to protect against unauthorized resets.

checks.label: ADB Over Wi-Fi
checks.description: Risky if enabled
checks.remediation: Disable wireless debugging in Settings > Developer Options > Wireless Debugging.

checks.label: Bootloader Locked
checks.description: 1 means locked bootloader; 0 means unlocked
checks.remediation: Re-lock the bootloader via 'fastboot flashing lock' after restoring stock firmware.

checks.label: Fastboot Unlock Allowed
checks.description: Fastboot OEM unlock must be disabled
checks.remediation: Disable OEM unlocking in Developer Options and verify the carrier or OEM policy disallows it.

checks.label: OEM Unlock Disabled (Global Setting)
checks.description: OEM unlock should be disallowed by policy (0)
checks.remediation: Set 'settings put global oem_unlock_allowed 0' or disable OEM unlocking in Developer Options.

checks.label: FRP Partition Path Set
checks.description: Factory Reset Protection partition path configured
checks.remediation: Ensure the device tree defines ro.frp.pst pointing to the persistent storage partition for FRP.

checks.label: Verity Mode (cmdline)
checks.description: dm-verity must fail closed. Secure runtime modes are 'enforcing', 'eio' (the AVB-recommended MANAGED_RESTART_AND_EIO) and 'panicking'. Insecure values are 'ignore_corruption'/'logging' (corrupt data may be returned) and 'disabled' (no verity).
checks.remediation: Flash stock vbmeta without the --disable-verity flag. Avoid ignore_corruption/logging error modes; use AVB_HASHTREE_ERROR_MODE_MANAGED_RESTART_AND_EIO.

checks.label: dm-verity-backed Partitions Mounted
checks.description: At least one partition should be backed by dm-verity
checks.remediation: Reflash stock firmware and vbmeta to restore dm-verity-backed partition mounts.

checks.label: AVB/Verity Success in dmesg
checks.description: Kernel logs should show AVB/verity success (if accessible)
checks.remediation: Verify dmesg access permissions. Reflash stock images if AVB/verity messages are absent.

checks.label: Test-keys Build
checks.description: Test-keys in fingerprint indicates insecure engineering/debug build
checks.remediation: Flash an official release-signed firmware build from the OEM. Do not use test-keys builds in production.

checks.label: Init Files Metadata Snapshot
checks.description: Informational snapshot of /init and /init.rc file metadata (size, mtime, mode). Note: this does NOT detect tampering by itself; it captures filesystem metadata for post-audit review. For real tampering detection, compare against a known-good hash (see dm-verity / Verified Boot checks elsewhere in this category).
checks.remediation: Compare /init and /init.rc sizes and timestamps against known-good stock images for anomalies.

checks.label: app_process Filesystem Attributes
checks.description: Informational snapshot of lsattr output on app_process* binaries (which are the Zygote entry points). Note: this does NOT detect tampering by itself; it captures filesystem extended attributes (e.g. immutable bit) for post-audit review.
checks.remediation: Reflash the stock system image if unexpected attributes are found on app_process binaries.

checks.label: VBMeta Digest (verified-boot fingerprint)
checks.command: D=$(getprop ro.boot.vbmeta.digest 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$D" ]; then D=$(grep -o 'androidboot.vbmeta.digest=[^ ]*' /proc/cmdline 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); fi; echo "$D"
checks.description: AVB VBMeta digest - a SHA-256/512 hash over all vbmeta structs (including chained partitions). It is the runtime fingerprint of the entire verified-boot metadata and the value used in hardware-backed attestation. Record it per firmware build and diff across audits to detect vbmeta tampering. Empty means the bootloader did not export it (non-AVB or older device).
checks.remediation: Record this digest per firmware build as a known-good baseline. A change on the same build indicates vbmeta was modified - reflash stock vbmeta with 'fastboot flash vbmeta vbmeta.img'. With --save-baseline / --baseline this comparison is automatic.

checks.label: dm-verity Managed Error-Mode Policy
checks.command: M=$(grep -o 'androidboot.veritymode.managed=[^ ]*' /proc/cmdline 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); I=$(grep -o 'androidboot.vbmeta.invalidate_on_error=[^ ]*' /proc/cmdline 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); echo "managed=${M:-unset} invalidate_on_error=${I:-unset}"
checks.description: Records the AVB hashtree error-handling policy (androidboot.veritymode.managed and androidboot.vbmeta.invalidate_on_error). 'managed=yes' is the recommended AVB_HASHTREE_ERROR_MODE_MANAGED_RESTART_AND_EIO state machine for Android; 'invalidate_on_error=yes' corresponds to RESTART_AND_INVALIDATE. Informational - pair with the 'Verity Mode' checks to confirm verity fails closed.
checks.remediation: For Android devices use AVB_HASHTREE_ERROR_MODE_MANAGED_RESTART_AND_EIO so corruption triggers a managed restart/EIO rather than serving corrupt data.

checks.label: VBMeta Hash Algorithm Not Weak
checks.description: Hash algorithm protecting the top-level vbmeta struct. sha1 is cryptographically weak for verified boot; modern devices use sha256 or sha512. Empty/unset on devices that do not export the property.
checks.remediation: Rebuild and flash vbmeta signed with a SHA-256 or SHA-512 algorithm (set BOARD_AVB_ALGORITHM to e.g. SHA256_RSA4096 or SHA512_RSA4096).

checks.label: Kernel CONFIG_DM_VERITY_AVB Support
checks.description: CONFIG_DM_VERITY_AVB lets the kernel invalidate the current slot on dm-verity corruption, required for AVB_HASHTREE_ERROR_MODE_RESTART_AND_INVALIDATE. 'absent' means /proc/config.gz is not exposed (common) - this is informational, not a failure.
checks.remediation: If using the RESTART_AND_INVALIDATE error mode, build the kernel with CONFIG_DM_VERITY_AVB=y. Not required for EIO/managed modes.

checks.label: VBMeta Size Baseline
checks.description: Size in bytes of the verified vbmeta blob, exported by the bootloader. Record alongside the VBMeta digest as a known-good baseline; an unexpected change on the same firmware build is a tamper indicator. Empty on devices that do not export it.
checks.remediation: Informational baseline. Capture per firmware build and compare across audits (use --save-baseline / --baseline).

checks.label: Required libavb Version (vbmeta)
checks.description: libavb version required to verify the vbmeta struct (distinct from ro.boot.avb_version). Informational - confirms the vbmeta was AVB-verified and records the version for fleet consistency.
checks.remediation: Informational. Ensure the bootloader's libavb version matches the version avbtool used to sign the images.
